Option.AutoPromotion.ClearMode.desc: Choose which map mode to clear. Story / Main will try the Path stages once it is finished; Exploration mode only clears the exploration map.
Option.AutoPromotion.ConsumeCandy.desc: Automatically consume candy when stamina runs out (every candy, regardless of expiry).
Option.AutoPromotion.SelectEvent.CityOfT: Floor It! To the Golden City
Option.AutoPromotion.SelectEvent.RemitCu: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
Option.AutoPromotion.SelectEvent.desc: “Current page” means you open the event stage map page manually before running (the default). Picking a specific event navigates there from the game home screen: Entrance → Vision → find the matching card → event/main story → start clearing.
Option.Combat.CustomCount.desc: When off, stamina is drained completely.
Option.Combat.DropReport.desc: Whether to record main-story stage drops and report them to [Necessary Records](https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cd5MWeCl5bKw) (main-story stages only). This option has no effect outside the CN server.
Option.Combat.StageMain.Incense_13_15: Golden Grass Incense (Goldbell Spirit Bottle): 13-15 Hard
Option.CombatActivity.RerunMode.desc: When on, only rerun events are farmed; when off, the current event is farmed.
Option.EightBitArcade.MovementInput.desc: Movement uses the keyboard arrow keys by default. If your character does not move once the movement screen opens, switch to tapping the game screen instead.
Option.Limbo.WeeklyShallowSleepOnly: Only Claim Weekly Shallow Sleep Rewards
Option.Limbo.WeeklyShallowSleepOnly.desc: When on, only the weekly Shallow Sleep rewards are claimed and no Deep Sleep auto-battles are run.
Option.Psychube.CandyCount.desc: Note that gummy bears (the 5-stamina candy dropped in the main story) are always consumed in full and do not count towards this number.
Option.Psychube.CandyExpiry.desc: Which candy expiry windows are allowed to be consumed.
Option.Psychube.ContinuousCandy.desc: When on, as much candy as possible is consumed each time the candy screen opens; when off, only one candy is consumed per visit.
Option.Psychube.CustomCandyCount.desc: When off, every candy that matches the expiry setting is consumed.
Option.Psychube.DismissCandyPrompt.desc: Dismisses the “do not remind me again today” prompt shown when consuming candy. Doing so may result in more candy being consumed than intended — choose carefully!
Option.Psychube.DoubleAnalysisBattle.des: Whether to run bonus battles while Double Analysis is active.
Option.RedeemCode.CustomCodes.Code.msg: Separate multiple codes with spaces, commas or semicolons.
Option.SwitchAccount.TargetAccount.Accou: Leave empty to scroll to the bottom of the account list and switch to the last account. If filled in, the list is scrolled page by page to find that account, and the task fails if it cannot be found.
Option.Wilderness.GatherEssence.desc: Does not swap the essence being transported, so there is no extra gain.
Preset.DailyEvent.desc: Farms event stages during non-main-story versions.
Preset.DailyIdle.desc: Use when there is no event running or the shop is already cleared; performs the regular farming routine.
Preset.MiniGames.desc: Every task in this preset has to be run on its own.
Task.AutoPromotion.desc:
Open the event stage map page manually before running this task.
Story / Main — unfinished stages marked with a grey star next to the number are detected and cleared in order; once they are done the Path stages are attempted, and the task ends normally if there are none.
Exploration mode — unlocked later in an event. If you are on the Story page it switches to Exploration first; main-story maps with no Exploration mode are skipped.
If the task reaches a mini-game, a special tutorial or any other screen it cannot handle, it stops on its own (error screenshots go to debug/on_error). Finish that part manually, return to the stage map page and run it again to continue.
Task.BalancedFarming.desc: Reads the counts of the 12 purple main-story materials in the warehouse and automatically farms the best stage for whichever material you have the least of.
Task.Bank.desc: Purchases already made in the current cycle on the current account are skipped automatically.
Task.CharUpgrade.desc: For veteran players. Once you are on a character's detail page it upgrades automatically (resonance and level) until materials run out or the cap is reached (Insight 3 / Resonance 9). Only attribute breakthrough materials are farmed, and candy is consumed directly.
Task.Colosseum.desc:
This feature only sweeps the first floor of the Arena. Updated for version 3.8.
Please open the Arena page manually.
Task.Combat.desc:
Chapter 13 is out — please help farm the new stages so the one-image guide can be updated. Thanks♪(･ω･)ﾉ
Click to enlarge the image; material stages only.
![bydjl](resource/announcement/images/mojing_tjb.jpg)
Task.CombatActivity.desc: While a main-story version is live, leaving rerun mode off will simply skip this task. If you want to farm main-story stages, use Regular Combat instead.
Task.CompleteInduction.desc: Play one full round manually to finish the tutorial first, then start the task on the screen with the mini-game's "Start Research" button.
Task.CritterCrash.desc:
Start on the Critter Crash screen shown below. CN server version 3.5 is supported.
![CCMain](resource/announcement/images/CCMain.png)
Task.EightBitArcade.desc: Farm tokens in the 8-bit Arcade Show. Start the task from the game's main screen.
Task.Limbo.desc: Make sure the first-half and second-half formations are not the same. Both the old and the reworked formation systems are supported, as are custom formation names; formations beyond the first four may be supported in future.
Task.Lucidscape.desc: Make sure the first-half and second-half formations are not the same. Both the old and the reworked formation systems are supported, as are custom formation names; formations beyond the first four may be supported in future.
Task.MusesBox.desc:
Automatic score farming for Muses Box
Run this task with "Start the Party" showing in the bottom-right corner
Task.PreStormProtocol.desc:
This task has to be run on its own. Leave the game on the mini-game main screen before starting.
There are two cases:
1. You have not beaten the day-three boss in the tutorial (clicking "Start Simulation" does not open the difficulty selection screen).
2. You have beaten the day-three boss in the tutorial (clicking "Start Simulation" opens the difficulty selection screen).

Pick the option that matches your situation.
Task.RedeemCode.desc: Codes already used on the current account are skipped automatically.
Task.SSReopen.desc: This task follows the task list and only supports rerun stages from past events you have already cleared.
Task.SeriesOfDusks: Outside Deduction: The Series of Dusks
Task.SeriesOfDusks.desc:
This feature has two modes. Catalyst selection only applies outside fast mode; with fast mode on, only the Arcane Lantern is used to farm the first floor.
Fast mode
1. Before using it, max out `Engrave Growth - Song of Guidance` and `Engrave Growth - Building Code`.
2. Raise the difficulty as high as you can (difficulty 11 gives the best credit efficiency) and max out the credit-efficiency bonuses in the tech tree, so the score does not fall short of 2,500 and lose the token run.
Non-fast mode
1. You can pin (mark) four characters in your box to deploy them.
2. A healer is recommended in the team.
3. M9A cannot tell whether auto-battle is on — please set it yourself.
⚠ See the documentation for full details.
Task.SwitchAccount.desc:
Leave the field empty to scroll to the bottom of the account list and switch to the last account. If a target account is given, the list is scrolled page by page until it is found; the task fails if it cannot be found.
You can queue further tasks after the switch, so several accounts and configurations can be run in one go.
This feature currently supports the Official server only, and only an actual unscaled resolution of 1280×720 with the emulator DPI set to 240.
Task.TheAlarm: When the Alarm Sounds (high investment required)
Task.TheAlarm.desc:
This feature does not swap characters and takes every debuff, so it only suits a well-built team left to run on its own. Recommended team: the Big Three (37 / Eternity / 6) plus Tutu and 66, or a pursuit team. Open the When the Alarm Sounds main page manually before use (the one showing "Rain Mark Tracking" and "Rain Mark Disposal").
"Fast" options go straight to the boss stage with no fifth-slot buff, which suits a fully built Big Three plus two healers. Without fast mode the fifth-slot buff is maxed out first, which makes the clear more reliable.
Test team: Ulrich + Eternity + Melmoth + Semmelweis + Tutu (put the main DPS in the fifth slot).
Task.TheSyndromeOfSilence: Outside Deduction: The Syndrome of Silence
Task.TheSyndromeOfSilence.desc:
From version 3.8 the task can start from the game home screen; on 3.7 you have to open the screen below manually.![SOSMain](resource/announcement/images/SOSMain.png)M9A cannot tell whether auto-battle is on, so make sure your last battle used auto-battle (on 3.7, set your formation up in advance).
⚠ Clear at least the first floor manually before using this; see the documentation for full details.
Task.TrustReward.desc: Start the task from the main interface; trust rewards for your characters will be collected.
Task.UTTU.desc: Start once your team is set up on the first floor of each UTTU phase. All four floors are cleared automatically; trial characters are removed on the next floor, so use your own characters.![uttu](resource/announcement/images/uttu.png)
Task.WarehouseInventory.desc: Scans the counts of every template-configured material on the warehouse materials page and saves them to config/warehouse_inventory.json for future features.
